entities.name: Message type information element
entities.description: The message type IE identifies the type of NAS message being transmitted. Its structure and usage are defined in 3GPP TS 24.007.

entities.name: Attach request
entities.description: EMM message used by the UE to initiate an attach procedure to the network.

entities.name: Attach accept
entities.description: EMM message sent by the network to accept an attach request from the UE.

entities.name: Activate default EPS bearer context request
entities.description: ESM message used to activate a default EPS bearer context for the UE.

entities.name: Activate dedicated EPS bearer context request
entities.description: ESM message used to activate a dedicated EPS bearer context for the UE.

entities.name: PDN connectivity request
entities.description: ESM message used by the UE to request connectivity to a PDN.

entities.name: Tracking area update request
entities.description: EMM message used by the UE to update its tracking area information with the network.

entities.name: Authentication request
entities.description: EMM message sent by the network to initiate authentication with the UE.

entities.name: Security mode command
entities.description: EMM message used by the network to activate NAS security functions.

entities.name: EMM status
entities.description: EMM message used to report error conditions in the EMM protocol.

entities.name: ESM status
entities.description: ESM message used to report error conditions in the ESM protocol.

relations.description: Attach request message contains the message type IE to identify it as an attach request.
Attach accept message contains the message type IE to identify it as an attach accept.
Activate default EPS bearer context request contains the message type IE to identify it as an ESM message.
Activate dedicated EPS bearer context request contains the message type IE to identify it as an ESM message.
PDN connectivity request contains the message type IE to identify it as an ESM message.
Tracking area update request contains the message type IE to identify it as an EMM message.
Authentication request contains the message type IE to identify it as an EMM message.
Security mode command contains the message type IE to identify it as an EMM message.
EMM status message contains the message type IE to identify it as an EMM message.
ESM status message contains the message type IE to identify it as an ESM message.
